requirements.text: Online borrowing and returning of books without needing to visit the desk.
A real-time search function for book availability, with filtering options by title, author, genre, and format.
A simple study room booking system that allows selection of date and time slots and provides room capacity information.
Email reminders for book due dates, with an option for push notifications through a mobile app.
The system must ensure a user-friendly and convenient experience for students.
